newsitem.title: CHINA: Otis sells Shanghai metro 120 escalators.
newsitem.headline: Otis sells Shanghai metro 120 escalators.

text.p: Otis Elevator, a unit of United Technologies Corp, said it will supply 120 escalators worth 24.5 million marks to the Shanghai metro.
The 120 heavy-duty escalators will be installed in 10 metro stations in the first phase of the second Shanghai line, which is expected to be completed in early 2000, it said.

The German government will provide loans to buy the escalator equipment and the escalators will be designed, developed and manufactured in an Otis factory in Stadthagen, Germany, a companys statement said.
Otis provided 48 escalators for the first Shanghai metro line, which were installed by Shanghai Otis, a Sino-U.S. joint venture, the statement said. It gave no further details.
